header: Why asset history belongs in one register
description: A chiller that has been repaired four times in eighteen months is a replacement conversation, not a fifth callout. That only becomes visible when every visit, part and reading lands against the unit itself rather than in whichever technician's notebook was to hand.

items.title: One record per unit
items.description_text: Serial number, install date, warranty end and every visit since, on a single page.

items.title: QR label on the equipment
items.description_text: A technician scans the unit and the full history opens, with no site or asset lookup.

items.title: Repeat failures surface early
items.description_text: Units with three or more callouts in a year are flagged in the weekly contract report.

items.title: Handover without a handover
items.description_text: A new technician on the round starts with the same history the regular one had.
